accepted_plan_boundaries: Canonical495033/tree1d421 and actual Mac bc1fc6b8 normal product/receipts remain bound; historical normal360 consumer evidence is not transferred.
The exact configured cohort is main,trnm,hepta-ui,hepta,hepta-backend. Full local1/2/3 state/order/usage is preserved; trnm raw-empty and effective inheritance are distinguished.

Original hostId, publishNew, manageOrder, scheduler omissions, model, runtime and homeScope remain unchanged. Four connection-field changes and separately enumerated owned filesystem/channel isolation are distinct.
Current captures are read-only non-global-atomic snapshots with terminal source fences; drift is refused rather than restored over production.

Actual installed SDK/native initialize, ephemeral token login and account/read(false) under inherited kernel egress denial are the intended proof. No provider/model call, token fabrication or forced eligibility is proposed.
Each aggregate phase retains one120-second deadline, with start15/account8/close3 caps. Unknown controller/manager wrapper limits must be explicitly new.
Owned launchd labels/root are separate from ai.openclaw.gateway and relays. KeepAlive=false qualification is not production KeepAlive=true qualification.
Same-T5 custody is not off-host recovery. Historical Linux recovery does not count as current Mac backup; new current encryption/restore stays a separately bound action.

implementation_requirements_before_execu.source_basis: Original consumer hard-codes main and a single nativeSpawned==0 entry. Original observer poll returns after handled=True and closes response_write after one ACK.
implementation_requirements_before_execu.minimum_change: Use an exact five-agent ledger for initial and cold phases. Bind each actual selected agent/runtime/homeScope and native generation to an independent nonce, immutable PID/birth/executable lineage, RPC result and close/reap result. A previous agent's verified boolean cannot qualify another agent.
implementation_requirements_before_execu.narrow_option: Retain the proven single-use observer per owned Node/native attempt, sequentially under one shared phase deadline, rather than silently broadening its authority. Distinguish one full-cohort AuthBus cycle from per-agent native consumption proof.

implementation_requirements_before_execu.source_basis: Original observer.verify_chain requires node.ppid==outer_pid, node.pgid==node_pid, matching UID and actual executable; anonymous pipes are created by that direct parent.
implementation_requirements_before_execu.minimum_change: The owned launchd program should run the fixed wrapper that itself creates the anonymous observer pipes and Popen sandbox-exec/Node. The external orchestrator owns only the exact manager label transition. Do not weaken direct-parent/birth checks or pretend the external caller PGID owns a launchd-created Node.
implementation_requirements_before_execu.sandbox_boundary: Apply the actual sandbox at the consumer entry in this launched wrapper and inherit it through installed launcher/native. Parent process observation and volume guarding remain in their reviewed owner context.

implementation_requirements_before_execu.source_basis: Plan JSON says restore SDK local+effective first, while its own trnm invariant correctly forbids materializing inherited profiles into an empty primary row.
implementation_requirements_before_execu.minimum_change: CAS only real durable local/raw records and exact updated_at/absence. After related local records are restored, recompute effective views using the actual SDK and compare them. Do not write effective inherited contents into trnm.
implementation_requirements_before_execu.phase_custody: Keep initial and cold distinct private state roots, five-agent checkpoint maps and full six-cache custody, preserving the original driver's two independent materializations. Require exact initial/cold/their-two-inverse phase identities, with per-agent once CAS bookkeeping and explicit partial/conflict outcomes.

implementation_requirements_before_execu.minimum_change: Specify each initial/cold/inverse manager generation, exact label, bootstrap/print/bootout dispatch and ownership receipt. Require exact label absence before first bootstrap and known bootout plus complete process-tree closure before a later cold bootstrap. No ambiguous manager transition advances the graph.
implementation_requirements_before_execu.deadlines: Every native15/8/3 operation is clamped to the same original120-second aggregate phase remainder; five agents do not get five phase windows. Volume/manager outer bounds remain explicitly separate and finite, named NEW when no historical cap is recovered.

qualification_notes: Actual selector choice must be reported without resetting usage or forcing a profile. A local fallback selected in a run supplies only the evidence actually observed; it does not silently prove consumption of every managed credential.

Host inbox proposals and canonical profile enrollment are distinct authority states. Preserving publishNew must not be achieved by unreported harness suppression or by treating a proposal as an enrollment grant.
Native local-auth success under denied egress does not prove provider validity, model availability or zero blocked background attempts.
An executable candidate and its fixed inventories still require source and inert/component review; this is a plan assessment, not runtime authorization.
